name: work-package-link-and-assertions
summary: The checklist-to-review-item link is now made through the select and read back from the store, and the readiness assertion states its own expected value and matches it exactly. Tests only; the component and the domain are untouched.

tests.what: a new test seeds one review item, opens the package form, adds a checklist entry, reads the link select's options, fires the change, re-reads the select's value, saves, and asserts review.packages[0].checklist[0].reviewItemIds equals [item.id]. The readiness assertion no longer calls packageReadiness: it asserts the checklist status is 確認済, matches the state cell against /^準備完了$/, and asserts there is no blocker. The packageReadiness import went with it.

falsifiability.mutation: the link select's onChange made a no-op
falsifiability.observed: 1 failed | 5 passed (6) — 'links a checklist entry to a review item through the select'

falsifiability.mutation: packageReadiness returns 準備完了（例外あり） on the clean path
falsifiability.observed: 1 failed | 5 passed (6) — 'creates a package, confirms a required unlinked item, and derives the core readiness state'. Before this step the same mutation left all five passing, which is what C4 claimed.

falsifiability.mutation: packageReadiness returns 準備未完 on the clean path
